title: Uber and China’s Pony.ai plan to launch robotaxis in London
key_facts: Uber and Pony.ai said on Thursday 8 Oct 2026 they will begin testing Pony.ai's Gen-7 robotaxis in London in the coming weeks.
They have not said who will own and operate the London fleet.
Uber and Pony.ai first partnered in May 2025; they plan 2,000 robotaxis in Europe, starting in Zagreb, Croatia, where a service with Verne launched in August 2026.
Uber also partners with and invests in British startup Wayve and plans a separate London robotaxi service.
Uber has deals with more than 30 AV companies and expects AV trips in as many as 15 cities by end of 2026.
Pony.ai runs robotaxi services in four Chinese cities.
quote_evidence: The two companies said on Thursday that they would begin testing Pony.ai’s Gen-7 robotaxis in London in the coming weeks.
The London service will follow a similar model, although the companies have not said who will own and operate the fleet.
Uber expects to offer AV trips in as many as 15 cities globally by the end of 2026, roughly split between U.S. and international markets.
why_it_matters_hint: London could get two rival robotaxi services on Uber, one using Chinese technology.
notes: Plans and tests only; no date for paying rides.
